questions.explanation: Phasors: 5∠0° = 5 aur 5∠90° = 5j. Sum = 5 + 5j = 5√2∠45° (≈ 7.07∠45°). To v(t) = 5√2 cos(ωt + 45°). 10 cos(ωt + 45°) amplitudes ko seedha jodne ka trap hai — 90° alag phasors Pythagoras se judte hain.

questions.question: j⁷ kya hai?
questions.explanation: j² = −1, j³ = −j, j⁴ = 1, aur powers har 4 par repeat hoti hain. 7 = 4 + 3, to j⁷ = j³ = −j. j tab aata hai jab j³ ko j le lo (j² = −1 ka sign bhool kar) — yahi trap; −1 j² ke saath confuse karna hai; 1 j⁴ ya j⁸ hai.

questions.question: (3 − 4j)(3 + 4j) kya hai?
questions.explanation: z·z̄ = a² + b² = 9 + 16 = 25 (hamesha real, ≥ 0). Brackets kholo: 9 + 12j − 12j − 16j² = 9 + 16 = 25. −7 = 9 − 16 tab aata hai jab j² = +1 le lo — classic trap; 9 − 16j me j² ko j hi likh diya; 7 me sign aur square dono gadbad.

questions.question: Polar form 2∠30° ko rectangular form a + jb me likho.
questions.explanation: a = 2 cos 30° = 2·(√3/2) = √3, b = 2 sin 30° = 2·(1/2) = 1. To √3 + j. 1 + j√3 cos aur sin ko adla-badli karne ka trap hai (wo 2∠60° hai); √3 − j me angle ka sign galat hai; 2√3 + 2j modulus 2 se do baar multiply kar deta hai.

questions.question: (2∠40°)(3∠50°)/(6∠30°) kya hai?
questions.explanation: Multiply: moduli multiply, angles add: 6∠90°. Divide: 6/6 = 1, aur 90° − 30° = 60°. Result 1∠60°. 1∠120° divide karte waqt bhi angle jod dene ka trap hai; 6∠60° me modulus divide karna bhool gaye; −60° me subtraction ulta kiya.

questions.question: v(t) = 10 sin(ωt + 30°) ka cosine-reference phasor kya hai?
questions.explanation: sin θ = cos(θ − 90°), to 10 sin(ωt + 30°) = 10 cos(ωt + 30° − 90°) = 10 cos(ωt − 60°). Phasor 10∠−60°. 10∠30° sin ko seedha cos samajhne ka trap hai; 10∠120° me 90° ghatane ki jagah jod diya; 10∠60° me sign ulta ho gaya.

questions.question: Equation z³ = 8j ke saare roots kya hain?
questions.explanation: 8j = 8∠90°. Radius 8^(1/3) = 2, pehla angle 90°/3 = 30°, phir 360°/3 = 120° jodte jao: 2∠30°, 2∠150°, 2∠270°. Check: (2∠150°)³ = 8∠450° = 8∠90° ✓. 2∠90°, ... me angle ko 3 se divide nahi kiya — inka cube 8∠270° = −8j deta hai, yahi trap; 8∠... me modulus ka cube root bhool gaye; cubic ke 3 roots hote hain, ek nahi.

questions.question: (√3 + j)⁶ kya hai?
questions.explanation: Polar: |√3 + j| = 2, angle 30°, to √3 + j = 2∠30°. De Moivre: 2⁶∠(6·30°) = 64∠180° = −64. 64 tab aata hai jab angle 60° le lo (wo 1 + j√3 ka angle hai), kyunki 6·60° = 360° — angle ko tan⁻¹(b/a) se galat padhne ka trap; 64j aur −64j sirf 6·30° ki arithmetic galti (90° ya 270°) se aate hain.

questions.question: Euler/De Moivre se (cos θ + j sin θ)³ = cos 3θ + j sin 3θ. Real parts compare karke cos 3θ ko cos θ me likho.
questions.explanation: c = cos θ, s = sin θ lo. (c + js)³ = c³ + 3c²(js) + 3c(js)² + (js)³ = c³ − 3cs² + j(3c²s − s³). Real part: cos 3θ = c³ − 3cs² = c³ − 3c(1 − c²) = 4c³ − 3c. cos³θ − 3cos θ me s² = 1 − c² rakhna bhool gaye (s² ko 1 maan liya); 3cos θ − 4cos³θ sin 3θ = 3 sin θ − 4 sin³θ wale pattern ko cos par copy karne ka trap hai. Check θ = 0: cos 0 = 1 aur 4 − 3 = 1 ✓.

questions.question: v(t) = 3 cos(ωt) + 4 sin(ωt) ko ek single cosine A cos(ωt + φ) ki form me likho.
questions.explanation: Phasors: 3 cos ωt ⇒ 3∠0° = 3; 4 sin ωt = 4 cos(ωt − 90°) ⇒ −4j. Sum 3 − 4j: modulus 5, angle tan⁻¹(−4/3) ≈ −53.13° (fourth quadrant). To 5 cos(ωt − 53.13°). +53.13° sin ko +4j wala phasor maan lene ka trap hai; 7 amplitudes ko seedha jodna hai; 36.87° = tan⁻¹(3/4), ratio ulta le liya.

weeks.title: Rational, trigonometric, inverse trig and hyperbolic functions
weeks.summary: Is week aap rational functions ke asymptotes aur partial fractions, trig aur inverse trig functions ke derivatives-integrals, aur hyperbolic functions sinh, cosh ko samjhoge — saath me sinusoid ka RMS value integral se nikaloge.
concepts: **Rational function** p(x)/q(x): domain me q(x) ≠ 0. Jahan q = 0 aur p ≠ 0, wahan **vertical asymptote**. Horizontal asymptote degrees se: deg p < deg q ⇒ y = 0; barabar ⇒ y = leading coefficients ka ratio; deg p > deg q ⇒ koi horizontal asymptote nahi.

**Partial fractions**: (3x + 5)/((x + 1)(x + 2)) = A/(x + 1) + B/(x + 2). Dono taraf (x + 1)(x + 2) se multiply karo aur x = −1, x = −2 rakh ke A, B nikaalo. Phir har tukda ∫ dx/(x + a) = ln|x + a| deta hai. (Numerator ki degree ≥ denominator ho to pehle long division.)

**Trig derivatives**: (sin x)' = cos x, (cos x)' = −sin x, (tan x)' = sec²x (x radian me). Integrals ulte: ∫ cos x dx = sin x, ∫ sin x dx = −cos x. Chain rule: (sin ωt)' = ω cos ωt — isliye inductor me v = L di/dt sinusoidal current ko 90° aage le jaata hai.

**Power-reducing identities**: sin²x = (1 − cos 2x)/2, cos²x = (1 + cos 2x)/2. Inse ∫ sin² aur ∫ cos² aasaan hote hain, aur ek poore period par sin² ka average exactly 1/2 aata hai — RMS ka formula yahin se aata hai.

**Inverse trig**: sin⁻¹ x ka range [−π/2, π/2], cos⁻¹ x ka [0, π], tan⁻¹ x ka (−π/2, π/2). Isliye sin⁻¹(sin θ) = θ sirf tab jab θ us range me ho. Derivatives: (sin⁻¹ x)' = 1/√(1 − x²), (cos⁻¹ x)' = −1/√(1 − x²), (tan⁻¹ x)' = 1/(1 + x²).

**Inverse trig integrals**: ∫ dx/(1 + x²) = tan⁻¹ x + C, ∫ dx/√(1 − x²) = sin⁻¹ x + C. General: ∫ dx/(a² + x²) = (1/a)tan⁻¹(x/a) + C. Ye integrals rational functions ke partial fractions me irreducible quadratic aane par kaam aate hain.

**Hyperbolic functions**: cosh x = (eˣ + e⁻ˣ)/2, sinh x = (eˣ − e⁻ˣ)/2, tanh x = sinh x / cosh x. Identity cosh²x − sinh²x = 1 (trig jaisi par minus ke saath). Derivatives: (sinh x)' = cosh x, (cosh x)' = sinh x — yahan koi minus sign nahi aata. Latakti cable (catenary) ka shape cosh hota hai.

example.problem: v(t) = 10 sin(ωt) ka RMS value nikalo, jahan RMS² = (1/T)∫₀ᵀ v(t)² dt aur T = 2π/ω ek period hai.
steps: ∫₀ᵀ cos 2ωt dt = [sin 2ωt/(2ω)]₀ᵀ = sin(4π)/(2ω) − 0 = 0 (poore periods par cos ka integral 0).
Answer: **V_rms = 10/√2 ≈ 7.07 V** — har sinusoid ka RMS uske amplitude ÷ √2 hota hai.

mistakes: (cos x)' = sin x aur (cosh x)' = −sinh x likh dena — dono me sign ulta ho gaya. Trig me cos ka derivative −sin hai, hyperbolic me cosh ka derivative +sinh.
sin⁻¹(sin θ) ko hamesha θ maan lena. Agar θ range [−π/2, π/2] se bahar hai to us range me wo angle dhoondo jiska sine same ho.
Chain rule ka inner derivative bhool jaana: (tan⁻¹ 2x)' = 2/(1 + 4x²), sirf 1/(1 + 4x²) nahi.
revision: Period par sin² ka average = 1/2 ⇒ RMS = amplitude/√2.

questions.question: d/dx [tan⁻¹(2x)] kya hai?
questions.explanation: (tan⁻¹ u)' = u'/(1 + u²), u = 2x ⇒ 2/(1 + 4x²). 1/(1 + 4x²) me chain rule ka 2 chhoot gaya; 2/√(1 − 4x²) sin⁻¹ ka formula hai; 2 sec²(2x) tan(2x) ka derivative hai, tan⁻¹ ka nahi.

questions.question: sin⁻¹(sin(5π/6)) ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: sin(5π/6) = 1/2, aur sin⁻¹ ka range [−π/2, π/2] hai, to sin⁻¹(1/2) = π/6. 5π/6 range se bahar hai, isliye 'cancel kar do' wala trap galat hai. −π/6 ka sine −1/2 hai.

questions.question: d/dx [cosh(3x)] kya hai?
questions.explanation: (cosh u)' = sinh u · u', u = 3x ⇒ 3 sinh(3x). −3 sinh(3x) trig wali aadat se aata hai ((cos)' = −sin), par hyperbolic me minus nahi lagta. sinh(3x) me chain rule ka 3 bhool gaye.

questions.question: ∫₀¹ dx/(1 + x²) ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: Antiderivative tan⁻¹ x: tan⁻¹(1) − tan⁻¹(0) = π/4 − 0 = π/4. ln 2 tab aata hai jab ∫ dx/(1 + x) ka formula laga do (ln|1 + x|) — denominator me x² hai, x nahi. π/2 to x → ∞ tak ka integral hai.

questions.question: f(x) = (2x² + 1)/(x² − 4) ke asymptotes kya hain?
questions.explanation: Denominator x² − 4 = 0 ⇒ x = ±2, aur wahan numerator 9 ≠ 0, to dono vertical asymptotes hain. Degrees barabar (2 aur 2) ⇒ horizontal asymptote y = 2/1 = 2. 'Sirf x = 2' me x = −2 bhool gaye; y = 0 tab hota jab numerator ki degree chhoti hoti.

questions.question: ∫₀¹ dx/((x + 1)(x + 2)) ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: Partial fractions: 1/((x + 1)(x + 2)) = 1/(x + 1) − 1/(x + 2). Integral = [ln(x + 1) − ln(x + 2)]₀¹ = (ln 2 − ln 3) − (0 − ln 2) = 2 ln 2 − ln 3 = ln(4/3). ln(2/3) sirf upper limit hai — lower limit ka −(−ln 2) bhool gaye; ln 3 tab aata hai jab B ka sign + le lo: [ln(x + 1) + ln(x + 2)]₀¹ = ln 3.

questions.question: d/dx [sin(3x)] kya hai?
questions.explanation: Chain rule: cos(3x)·3 = 3 cos 3x. cos 3x andar ka 3 bhoolne ka trap hai; −3 cos 3x me cos ke derivative wala minus galti se sin par laga diya; 3 sin 3x me function badla hi nahi.

questions.question: cosh²(2) − sinh²(2) ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: Identity cosh²x − sinh²x = 1 har x ke liye hai, to x = 2 par bhi 1. −1 trig identity ke signs se confuse karna hai; cosh 4 = cosh²2 + sinh²2 wali identity hai — wo plus ke saath hoti hai, minus ke saath nahi, yahi trap; 0 tab jab cosh aur sinh ko barabar maan lo.

questions.question: cos⁻¹(−1/2) ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: cos⁻¹ ka range [0, π] hai. Is range me cos θ = −1/2 wala angle 2π/3 hai (cos 120° = −1/2). −π/3 range se bahar hai aur uska cos +1/2 hai; 4π/3 ka cos bhi −1/2 hai par wo [0, π] me nahi — range ignore karna yahan ka trap hai; π/3 ka cos +1/2 hai.

questions.question: (5x − 1)/((x − 1)(x + 1)) = A/(x − 1) + B/(x + 1). A aur B kya hain?
questions.explanation: Dono taraf (x − 1)(x + 1) se multiply: 5x − 1 = A(x + 1) + B(x − 1). x = 1: 4 = 2A ⇒ A = 2. x = −1: −6 = −2B ⇒ B = 3. Check: 2(x + 1) + 3(x − 1) = 5x − 1 ✓. A = 3, B = 2 me values adla-badli ho gayi; B = −3 me −6 = −2B ka sign galat solve hua; A = −2 me x = 1 par 4 = −2A le liya.

questions.question: ∫₀^(2π) sin²x dx ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: sin²x = (1 − cos 2x)/2. ∫₀^(2π) (1/2) dx = π, aur cos 2x poore periods par 0 deta hai. To π — yaani average 1/2 × length 2π. 0 tab aata hai jab sin²x ko sin x ki tarah positive-negative cancel hone wala maan lo — sin² kabhi negative nahi, yahi trap; 2π me 1/2 factor bhool gaye; π/2 sirf aadhe interval ka hai.

questions.question: ∫₋₂¹ dx/(x² + 4x + 13) ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: Square complete karo: x² + 4x + 13 = (x + 2)² + 9. ∫ dx/((x + 2)² + 3²) = (1/3)tan⁻¹((x + 2)/3). Limits: x = 1 ⇒ tan⁻¹(1) = π/4, x = −2 ⇒ tan⁻¹(0) = 0. Value = (1/3)(π/4) = π/12. π/4 me 1/a factor bhool gaye — sabse common trap; π/36 me 1/a² le liya; π/6 tan⁻¹ 1 ko π/2 samajhne se aata hai.

questions.question: d/dx [sin⁻¹(√x)] kya hai (0 < x < 1)?
questions.explanation: Chain rule: (sin⁻¹ u)' = u'/√(1 − u²), jahan u = √x, u' = 1/(2√x), u² = x. To 1/(2√x · √(1 − x)) = 1/(2√(x(1 − x))). 1/√(1 − x) inner derivative 1/(2√x) bhoolne ka trap hai; 1/(2√(1 − x²)) me u² ki jagah x² rakh diya; √x/√(1 − x) me inner derivative ko divide ki jagah multiply kar diya.

questions.question: ∫₀¹ (3x + 5)/((x + 1)(x + 2)) dx ki value kya hai?
questions.explanation: Partial fractions: 3x + 5 = A(x + 2) + B(x + 1). x = −1: 2 = A; x = −2: −1 = −B ⇒ B = 1. ∫₀¹ [2/(x + 1) + 1/(x + 2)] dx = 2[ln(x + 1)]₀¹ + [ln(x + 2)]₀¹ = 2 ln 2 + (ln 3 − ln 2) = ln 2 + ln 3 = ln 6. ln 12 = 2 ln 2 + ln 3 tab aata hai jab doosre term me lower limit wala ln 2 ghatana bhool jao — 'F(a) = 0 maan lena' wala trap; 2 ln 2 sirf pehla term hai; ln 3 sirf doosre term ka upper limit hai.

questions.question: sinh x = 3/4 hai. cosh x aur x kya hain?
questions.explanation: cosh²x = 1 + sinh²x = 1 + 9/16 = 25/16, aur cosh hamesha ≥ 1, to cosh x = 5/4. x ke liye: eˣ = sinh x + cosh x = 3/4 + 5/4 = 2 ⇒ x = ln 2. Check: sinh(ln 2) = (2 − 1/2)/2 = 3/4 ✓. √7/4 trig jaisi identity (1 − sinh²x) lagane ka trap hai — hyperbolic me cosh² − sinh² = 1; −5/4 possible nahi kyunki cosh x > 0; ln 3 tab aata hai jab eˣ galat jod ke 3 le lo.

weeks.title: First and second order linear ODEs
weeks.summary: Is week aap first-order linear ODE ko integrating factor se solve karoge (RC circuit ka charging curve), aur second-order constant-coefficient ODEs ko characteristic equation se — overdamped, critically damped aur underdamped RLC response samjhoge.
concepts: **ODE ki bhasha**: unknown function y(t) aur uske derivatives wali equation. **Order** = sabse oonchi derivative. **Linear** = y aur uske derivatives sirf pehli power me, aapas me multiply nahi (coefficients t ke function ho sakte hain). y'' + t y' = sin t linear hai, y' = y² nahi.
**First-order linear**: y' + P(t)y = Q(t). **Integrating factor** μ = e^(∫P dt) se multiply karo: (μy)' = μQ, to y = (1/μ)[∫ μQ dt + C]. Initial condition y(0) se C fix karo.

**RC circuit**: series RC ko DC source Vₛ se charge karo to RC·dv/dt + v = Vₛ. Solution v(t) = Vₛ + (v(0) − Vₛ)e^(−t/τ), jahan **time constant** τ = RC. Ek τ me ~63.2% raasta tay hota hai, aur 5τ me lagbhag 99.3% — practically settle.

**Second-order homogeneous**: ay'' + by' + cy = 0. y = e^(rt) try karo ⇒ **characteristic equation** ar² + br + c = 0. Do real alag roots r₁, r₂ ⇒ y = c₁e^(r₁t) + c₂e^(r₂t). Repeated root r ⇒ y = (c₁ + c₂t)e^(rt). Complex roots α ± jβ ⇒ y = e^(αt)(c₁ cos βt + c₂ sin βt).

**Series RLC**: L q'' + R q' + q/C = 0, characteristic Lr² + Rr + 1/C = 0. R² > 4L/C ⇒ **overdamped** (do real roots, bina oscillation ke dheere settle). R² = 4L/C ⇒ **critically damped** (sabse tez bina overshoot). R² < 4L/C ⇒ **underdamped** (decaying oscillation, β = damped frequency).

**Non-homogeneous**: ay'' + by' + cy = g(t) ka general solution y = y_h + y_p (homogeneous ka general + koi ek particular). **Undetermined coefficients**: g constant ⇒ y_p constant; g = e^(kt) ⇒ y_p = Ae^(kt); g = cos ωt ⇒ y_p = A cos ωt + B sin ωt. Agar guess y_h ka hissa ho (resonance), to t se multiply karo.

**Initial conditions**: second-order ke liye do chahiye, y(0) aur y'(0) (circuit me capacitor voltage aur inductor current). Pehle poora general solution likho (y_h + y_p), phir constants nikaalo — sirf y_h par conditions lagana common galti hai.

steps: Do real alag roots, to y = c₁e^(−t) + c₂e^(−3t) (overdamped jaisa response).
Pehli equation me rakho: −3c₂ + c₂ = 2 ⇒ c₂ = −1, c₁ = 3.
Answer: **y(t) = 3e^(−t) − e^(−3t)**, jo bina oscillate kiye 0 ki taraf jaata hai.

mistakes: Integrating factor e^(∫P dt) ki jagah e^P ya ∫P likh dena. Pehle equation ko y' + P y = Q form me lao (y' ka coefficient 1), tab P pehchano.
Complex roots α ± jβ par e^(βt) likh dena. Exponential me real part α jaata hai, aur β cos/sin ke andar frequency banta hai.
Resonance case me y_p = Ae^(kt) hi lagate rehna jab e^(kt) already y_h me hai — tab equation 0 = g(t) ban jaati hai. Aise me t·e^(kt) try karo.
revision: y' + Py = Q ⇒ μ = e^(∫P dt), (μy)' = μQ.
RC: v(t) = Vₛ + (v(0) − Vₛ)e^(−t/RC); τ = RC.
ar² + br + c = 0: real distinct / repeated / complex ⇒ teen forms.
RLC: R² vs 4L/C ⇒ over / critical / under damped.
y = y_h + y_p; resonance me t se multiply.

questions.question: ODE y'' + t·y' = sin t ka order aur type kya hai?
questions.explanation: Sabse oonchi derivative y'' hai, to second order. y'' aur y' dono pehli power me hain aur aapas me multiply nahi ho rahe; coefficient t sirf independent variable ka function hai, isliye linear. 'Nonlinear' wala trap ye sochna hai ki t·y' me product hai — par t variable nahi, coefficient hai.

questions.question: R = 10 kΩ aur C = 100 μF wala uncharged capacitor t = 0 par 5 V DC se charge hona shuru hota hai. t = 1 s par capacitor voltage lagbhag kitna hai?
questions.explanation: τ = RC = 10⁴ × 10⁻⁴ = 1 s. v(t) = 5(1 − e^(−t/τ)), to v(1) = 5(1 − e^(−1)) ≈ 5 × 0.632 = 3.16 V. 1.84 V = 5e^(−1) discharge ka formula hai (ya resistor ka voltage); 5 V tab jab capacitor ko turant full maan lo.

questions.question: ODE y' + (2/x)y = x (x > 0) ka integrating factor kya hai?
questions.explanation: P(x) = 2/x, ∫P dx = 2 ln x, to μ = e^(2 ln x) = x². 2 ln x sirf ∫P hai — exponential lena bhool gaye. e^(2x) tab aata hai jab P ko 2 samajh lo; 1/x² me sign ulta ho gaya.

questions.question: y'' + 4y = 0 ka general solution kya hai?
questions.explanation: Characteristic: r² + 4 = 0 ⇒ r = ±2j, to α = 0, β = 2 ⇒ y = c₁ cos 2t + c₂ sin 2t (bina damping ka oscillation). c₁e^(2t) + c₂e^(−2t) to r² − 4 = 0 ka answer hai — sign trap. cos 4t me √4 lena bhool gaye.

questions.question: Series RLC circuit me L = 1 H aur C = 0.25 F hai. Critical damping ke liye R kitna hona chahiye?
questions.explanation: Characteristic: Lr² + Rr + 1/C = r² + Rr + 4 = 0. Critical damping ⇔ discriminant 0 ⇔ R² = 4L/C = 4 × 1/0.25 = 16 ⇒ R = 4 Ω. 16 Ω tab aata hai jab R² ko hi R likh do; 2 Ω = √(L/C) hai, jisme 4 ka factor chhoot gaya.

questions.question: y'' − y = 2eᵗ ka ek particular solution y_p kya hai?
questions.explanation: Homogeneous roots r = ±1, to eᵗ already y_h me hai (resonance) — y_p = Aeᵗ rakhne par 0 = 2eᵗ aata hai, impossible. Isliye y_p = Ateᵗ: y' = A(1 + t)eᵗ, y'' = A(2 + t)eᵗ, to y'' − y = 2Aeᵗ = 2eᵗ ⇒ A = 1. y_p = teᵗ. 2teᵗ me A ko right side ka 2 maan liya, bina calculate kiye.

questions.question: y'' − 5y' + 6y = 0 ka general solution kya hai?
questions.explanation: Characteristic equation r² − 5r + 6 = 0 ⇒ (r − 2)(r − 3) = 0 ⇒ r = 2, 3 (real, alag). To y = c₁e^(2t) + c₂e^(3t). e^(−2t), e^(−3t) roots ka sign ulta lene ka trap hai (wo r² + 5r + 6 ke roots hain); (c₁ + c₂t) form sirf repeated root ke liye hai; cos/sin sirf complex roots par aate hain.

questions.question: R = 3.3 kΩ aur C = 100 μF wala RC circuit practically kitne time me settle ho jaata hai (5τ)?
questions.explanation: τ = RC = 3300 × 100 × 10⁻⁶ = 0.33 s. 5τ = 1.65 s, jab tak lagbhag 99.3% raasta tay ho jaata hai. 0.33 s sirf ek τ hai (~63.2%) — yahi trap; 3.3 s aur 16.5 s μ ko 10⁻⁶ ki jagah 10⁻⁵ lene se aate hain.

questions.question: Inme se kaunsi ODE linear hai?
questions.explanation: Linear ka matlab y aur uske derivatives sirf pehli power me, aapas me multiply nahi. y'' + 3y' + 2y = eᵗ me right side t ka function hai — usse linearity nahi tootti. y² (power 2), y·y'' (product) aur sin y (y ka nonlinear function) teeno nonlinear banate hain. eᵗ dekh ke 'nonlinear' bol dena trap hai — dekhna y par hai, t par nahi.

questions.question: y' + 3y = 6, y(0) = 0 ka solution kya hai?
questions.explanation: Integrating factor e^(3t): (e^(3t)y)' = 6e^(3t) ⇒ e^(3t)y = 2e^(3t) + C ⇒ y = 2 + Ce^(−3t). y(0) = 0 ⇒ C = −2. y = 2(1 − e^(−3t)). Steady value 6/3 = 2 hai, 6 nahi — 6 wala option 3 se divide karna bhool gaya, yahi trap; 2e^(−3t) initial condition y(0) = 2 deta hai; e^(3t) wala solution badhta hi jaata hai, settle nahi hota.

questions.question: Series RLC me L = 1 H, C = 0.01 F aur R = 10 Ω hai. Circuit ka response kaisa hoga?
options: Kuch nahi keh sakte bina initial conditions ke
questions.explanation: R² aur 4L/C compare karo: R² = 100, 4L/C = 4/0.01 = 400. R² < 4L/C ⇒ underdamped (decaying oscillation). Critical ke liye R = 20 Ω chahiye hota. 'Overdamped' inequality ulti yaad rakhne ka trap hai; damping type sirf L, R, C se decide hota hai — initial conditions sirf constants c₁, c₂ badalti hain.

questions.question: y'' + 2y' + 5y = 0, y(0) = 1, y'(0) = 1. Solution kya hai?
questions.explanation: r² + 2r + 5 = 0 ⇒ r = −1 ± 2j. y = e^(−t)(c₁ cos 2t + c₂ sin 2t). y(0) = c₁ = 1. y'(0) = −c₁ + 2c₂ = 1 ⇒ c₂ = 1. y = e^(−t)(cos 2t + sin 2t). (1/2) sin 2t tab aata hai jab y' nikalte waqt e^(−t) ka derivative (−c₁ wala term) bhool jao — yahi trap; e^(2t)(cos t + sin t) me α aur β adla-badli ho gaye — exponential me real part jaata hai; minus wala option y'(0) = −3 ke liye hota.

questions.question: y' − 2y = eᵗ, y(0) = 0 ka solution kya hai?
questions.explanation: P = −2, integrating factor e^(−2t): (e^(−2t)y)' = e^(−2t)·eᵗ = e^(−t). Integrate: e^(−2t)y = −e^(−t) + C ⇒ y = −eᵗ + Ce^(2t). y(0) = 0 ⇒ C = 1. y = e^(2t) − eᵗ. Check: y' − 2y = (2e^(2t) − eᵗ) − (2e^(2t) − 2eᵗ) = eᵗ ✓. eᵗ − e^(2t) ∫e^(−t) dt = +e^(−t) wala sign error hai; e^(2t) + eᵗ y(0) = 2 deta hai; t·e^(2t) resonance wala form hai jo yahan nahi lagta, kyunki eᵗ homogeneous solution e^(2t) ka hissa nahi.

questions.question: y'' + y = 3 cos 2t ka particular solution y_p kya hai?
questions.explanation: g = cos 2t, aur cos 2t homogeneous solutions (cos t, sin t) ka hissa nahi, to y_p = A cos 2t + B sin 2t. y_p'' = −4y_p, to y_p'' + y_p = −3A cos 2t − 3B sin 2t = 3 cos 2t ⇒ A = −1, B = 0. y_p = −cos 2t. cos 2t sign bhoolne ka trap hai (−4 + 1 = −3); 3/5 tab aata hai jab −4A + A ko 4A + A le lo; t sin 2t wala form resonance ka hai, jo yahan nahi (frequency 2 ≠ 1).

questions.question: R = 5 kΩ, C = 100 μF wala capacitor shuru me 2 V par hai. t = 0 par 10 V DC source joda jaata hai. t = 1 s par capacitor voltage lagbhag kitna hai?
questions.explanation: τ = RC = 5000 × 100 × 10⁻⁶ = 0.5 s, to t/τ = 2. v(t) = Vₛ + (v(0) − Vₛ)e^(−t/τ) = 10 + (2 − 10)e^(−2) = 10 − 8 × 0.135 ≈ 8.92 V. 8.65 V = 10(1 − e^(−2)) — initial 2 V ignore karne ka trap; 1.08 V sirf baaki gap (8e^(−2)) hai; 9.73 V me (v(0) − Vₛ) ki jagah sirf v(0) = 2 V ko decay karwa diya.
